reason: I already order through an agent I know and it mostly works fine, so why would I send my money up front to a page I've never heard of? On my income, losing 35,000 IQD to a new name would really hurt.
objection: Paying for the item before anything happens, to a new company with no reviews or people I know who used it. If it never arrives, who do I chase?
would_change_my_mind: A friend or an influencer I follow showing a real order that arrived, plus being able to pay everything on delivery for the first order.
